spectra_source.label: SBI_CGM fiducial pass (CLOUDY FG11)
spectra_source.text: Spectra from the SBI_CGM fiducial ray library (53,248 sightlines per galaxy; this page shows a stratified subset of about 700, equal numbers per b/R200c x inclination stratum, so raw counts are not covering fractions; each catalogue entry carries w_target, its weight to an area-uniform, isotropic sample within 1.5 R200c). Ionisation: CLOUDY FG11 tables (THOR) with Rahmati self-shielding instead of Trident HM2012; GPU Voigt optical depths (fp64) at 0.5 km/s over +-1500 km/s (H I damped wings beyond the window truncated; gas moving faster than 1500 km/s along the sightline falls outside the spectrum, flagged per ray); sightlines are Sobol-sampled, +-2 R200c long (half_kpc), impact parameter <= 1.5 R200c. Column densities are the ray columns of those tables; components are fitted with the SBI atomic data (f, Gamma). The SBI recipe labels the population 'engineering scope'. The disk frame, b and azimuth are ours; orientation words are inclination bands (face-on < 20 deg, edge-on >= 70 deg, random between). The 3D ion cubes are not from these tables: they use Trident HM2012 (H I from the TNG neutral fraction) within r <= 400 kpc, so a sightline drawn through a cube can differ from its spectrum by up to a few tenths of a dex (H I, Mg II, N V, C IV), and rays beyond 400 kpc pass outside it.
spectra_source.cubes: Trident HM2012, H I from the TNG neutral fraction, r <= 400 kpc
spectra_source.weights: w_target per entry (area-uniform b <= 1.5 R200c, isotropic)

selection.description: Direct THOR (thor-generic.sif) 3D Voronoi raytracing in 9+8 CLOUDY FG11 ion passes with SBI_CGM FP64 Voigt profiles across the halo cutout domain.
